description: Execute a prepared connector connection plan ONLY after user approval for its ring, account, environment and action, with its planId and confirm:true. This creates or repairs real Power Platform connections and their Dataverse references, including in production. This bridge never collects credentials: typed values or a choice of method use the Copilot Studio UI. New OAuth connections first try Copilot Studio server-side single sign-on as the displayed account, unless disabled in the plan. Verify Connected before reporting success; browser consent follows only a completed, unverified attempt or explicit service unavailability. Never retry uncertain writes. Repair can affect other users. Does not create, publish, or run agents or workflows.
name: copilot_studio_setup_connection
title: Apply approved connector setup
